IS 964 : 2023 Chemical Analysis of Silver Solder - Methods
ICS 39.060
ICS 39.060
MTD 10
MTD 10
1 SCOPE
This standard covers the methods of chemical analysis of various grades of silver solder. The methods described deal with the determination of silver, copper, cadmium, and zinc.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this standard, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
